patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Lightspeed Retail only if your buying job matches “Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspe” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Lightspeed Retail's shape. Workflow advantage: Lightspeed Retail leans omnichannel-retail; Tiendanube leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lightspeed Retail is Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspeed Payments ~1.5% card-present; eCommerce on highe; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Workflow coverage skew: Lightspeed Retail-leaning omnichannel-retail vs Tiendanube-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Lightspeed Retail — No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — Lightspeed Retail: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Third-party payment processors may incur a high monthly surcharge versus Lightspeed Payments (~1.5% card-present) — confirm live; Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: Lightspeed Retail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path · Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid Lightspeed Retail if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
